The references are IDENTITY AND PAINT STYLE ONLY; do NOT copy their page layout or scale. Use a WIDE-SPACE layout with massive clear gutters. Canvas1024x1536. Two columns, three rows. The character must be drawn as a SMALL MINIATURE only300px tall and maximum260px wide, centered inside each512x512cell. That means102pixels or more of COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent space above and below every figure; do not fill the cell with a large figure. Feet at cell-local y406. A clean transparent RGBA sprite sheet, no grid lines, no labels, no background, no reference atmosphere, no floor, no shadow, no halo. Full figure with all dreadlocks, hands, feet and weapons clear of cell edges. Left column has THREE distinct temporal poses facing RIGHT; right column has corresponding THREE distinct temporal poses facing LEFT, independently painted views, never apply mirror transform.
Identity reference1 is supplied masked Wolf: SAME engraved silver biomask, black dreadlocks with gold bands, tan spotted skin, black body netting, silver plated chest/thigh/shin armor, orange-brown apron and neck skull, original shoulder cannon and spear. Reference2/3 confirm right/left drawn costumes. CRITICAL EQUIPMENT LOCK: ONE pistol always held in the SAME anatomical pistol hand, kept DOWN by hip throughout ALL6poses. The OTHER wrist-blade arm stays low by the other hip throughout ALL6poses. NEVER swap pistol into wrist-blade hand, never add a weapon, never change the harness side. Use only head and upper torso to perform this taunt. Both arms remain in the same low pose throughout to avoid weapon drift.
TAUNT three distinct poses in time: row1 masked head level looking at opponent, calm body. Row2 lift chin noticeably and expand proud upper chest slightly while looking down at opponent, head above neutral, hands still unchanged low. Row3 tilt masked head towards opponent with a mocking small sideways nod, then settle shoulders toward neutral, hands still unchanged low. Legs planted, unchanged broad foot position. The small head/chest gestures are intentionally readable challenge, not breathing only. No mask removal, no shooting, no melee attack. Consistent small body scale across six poses and generous fully transparent gutters are mandatory. Retain source costume, these are gameplay adaptations rather than certified film animation.
